observations.source_title: LMT Onsrud MDF Cutting Data Recommendations
observations.source_page: MDF sheet, page 116, series 37-00/37-20, 1/4 in (shank) column: .004-.006 in/tooth
observations.notes: Printed cell, transcribed 2026-09-24 from the stored text sources/onsrud_mdf_cutting_data.txt (extrapolation P2, G2): line 22, the '37-00/37-20' row, prints .004-.006 under the '1/4' column of the header on line 21. The sheet prints one band for the two series; this row is the 37-00 half and the 37-20 half is its own row. The '1/4' column is the shank: sources/onsrud_pct19_catalog.txt lines 13-28 (page 20) list 37-01 to 37-15 with a 1/4 in shank, a tip of 0.005-0.090 in, 60 deg and 1 flute. So diameter_mm is left out, and the band carries to every tip unscaled. The sheet prints no hardness. hardness_value is the engine's Janka proxy for the family (the onsrud_tapered_ball.json convention); the older onsrud_ocr.json and onsrud_plywood.json flat rows carry none, and the P2 plan scores these rows with it. The sheet names no operation; trace / finish is the family of the other chamfer_vbit rows (P2 plan).
